sentences.en: The patient felt the worse for having taken the pills.
sentences.zh: 病人觉得吃了药丸之后状况更差了。

sentences.en: Because of the pills I took, the pain went away.
sentences.zh: 因为服用了药丸，疼痛消失了。

sentences.en: He takes the purple pill so he doesn't feel bored.
sentences.zh: 他吃紫药丸所以不会感到无聊。

senses.zh: 药丸，丸剂，无法逃避的讨厌事，屈辱事
服用药丸，把...制成药丸，被抢劫
起球粒，成丸状，阶段性完成
